weak_field_metric_contract.light_motion_relation: the same universal multiplier nu sources slow-body motion and light; no lens-only coefficient is allowed
weak_field_metric_contract.claim_boundary: This is a frozen weak-field metric closure for testing motion and light, not a covariant action or complete relativistic theory.

fixed_controls.matched_ordinary_geometry: cross-fitted ridge on the same source variables and their second-order interactions without a holographic interpretation
fixed_controls.flexible_radial_surface: cross-fitted cubic radial and surface-density basis with training-only regularization

wallaby.response_rule: Query only exact committed exploration name-plus-release identities after sample-freeze binding.

legacy_dr10.match_rule: Among finite positive extended-source candidates, minimize angular separation divided by 5 arcsec minus 0.05 log10 extinction-corrected r flux; require final separation at most 10 arcsec.
legacy_dr10.stellar_mass_rule: Use extinction-corrected g and i AB fluxes with the frozen Taylor et al. 2011 color-M/L approximation log10(M*/Msun)=1.15+0.70(g-i)-0.4*M_i; retain a 0.30 dex systematic audit.

independence.duplicate_rule: For every remaining physical name choose exactly one kinematic release before response access using the frozen release-priority order.
independence.freshness_claim: WALLABY responses are fresh only for identities outside every Item 10 exploration and reserved-confirmation role; reused response-blind HI profile predictors are disclosed.

sample_boundary.stratification: response-blind quartiles of total baryonic mass crossed with HI-to-optical screen-size ratio

predictor_quality.rule_timing: Frozen after source-only catalogue acquisition and before any rotation response access; rejected source matches are retained without replacement.

predictor_derivation.gas_mass: Mgas=1.35*MHI from the official corrected HI mass when available, otherwise source flux and frozen Hubble distance
predictor_derivation.stellar_profile: axisymmetric exponential disk with total frozen color-M/L stellar mass and scale radius R_eff/1.678
predictor_derivation.gas_profile: published projected HI surface-density rings integrated in physical annuli
predictor_derivation.screen_radius: outermost positive published HI surface-density radius; R_HI at 1 Msun/pc^2 is retained as a diagnostic when bracketed
predictor_derivation.baryonic_acceleration: g_bar=G*Mbar(<r)/r^2 as a declared sphericalized control projection; disk-kernel uncertainty is audited
predictor_derivation.nested_growth: d ln Mbar(<r)/d ln r from the source-only cumulative profile

evaluation.loss: equal-galaxy mean squared standardized log10 velocity residual

lensing_transfer.source_correction: The originally frozen arXiv identifiers 1107.2884 and 1207.3669 were unrelated papers. They were corrected before local source acquisition to the primary SWELLS III and V records; the WALLABY-selected formula did not change.
lensing_transfer.role: unchanged post-selection motion-and-light diagnostic: WALLABY supplies motion and SWELLS supplies light bending; this is not a blinded confirmation or a direct image-likelihood test
lensing_transfer.post_selection_pre_mapping_exposure: The complete published SWELLS III Table 1 was inspected after commit-binding the WALLABY formula but before this transfer mapping was frozen. Therefore the transfer is explicitly unblinded and diagnostic even though there is no formula or coefficient retuning.
lensing_transfer.sample_rule: Take the exact intersection of SWELLS III modelled lenses, independently published Chabrier bulge/disk masses, and published bulge/disk half-light radii; exclude every prefreeze-exposed/predecessor identity, complex merger J1037+3517, and any incomplete row; do not replace failures.

predictor_tables.swells_iii: Tables 3 and 4: circularized component half-light radii and Chabrier bulge/disk SPS masses
predictor_tables.swells_v: Table 1: physical component half-light radii and Chabrier bulge/disk SPS masses

lensing_transfer.response_table: SWELLS III Table 1 projected mass inside the critical curve, Einstein radius, lens redshift, and quoted uncertainties

baryonic_projection.bulge_profile: projected Sersic n=4 with cumulative fraction P(8,b4*(R/Re)^(1/4)) and b4=7.66924944
baryonic_projection.disk_profile: projected Sersic n=1 with cumulative fraction P(2,b1*R/Re) and b1=1.67834699
baryonic_projection.screen_radius: four times the published disk half-light radius; no fitted screen size
baryonic_projection.enclosed_fraction: Chabrier SPS bulge-plus-disk projected mass inside the circularized Einstein radius divided by total Chabrier SPS bulge-plus-disk mass
baryonic_projection.nested_growth: analytic d ln Mbar(<R)/d ln R of the frozen two-component projected profile
baryonic_projection.baryonic_acceleration: G*Mbar_projected(<R_E)/R_E^2 divided by the same a0 used for WALLABY
baryonic_projection.gas_treatment: No homogeneous cold-gas aperture measurement is available; primary mass is stellar-only and a symmetric 0.10 dex missing-gas audit is reported without changing the primary result

lensing_transfer.metric_mapping: Under the frozen Phi=Psi weak-field closure, use M_lens,pred=nu(u,H)*Mbar_projected(<R_E) as an aperture-level consistency proxy; do not interpret it as a solved relativistic lens equation.
lensing_transfer.loss: mean squared log10 predicted-to-published projected lens mass, with no fitted parameter and equal lens weight
lensing_transfer.claim_boundary: Published Einstein-radius/SIE-derived quantities and stellar-population masses are model-dependent summaries, so this transfer can falsify consistency but cannot establish a lensing theory.
